reproduction_manifest.notes: Reproduced ProtoMech full-latent F1 on protein family classification with ESM2-8M. Average F1=0.862+/-0.117 across 50 protein families (top by size) in Swiss-Prot InterPro (30% identity, >=50 seqs/family, MIN_POSITIVES=50). Within paper CI [0.63, 1.01], paper reports 0.82+/-0.19. ESM2 probe F1=0.921 (paper: 0.92). Recovery ratio 93.2% (paper: ~89%). Settings: CLT L6 D3200 sequential replacement, TopK_k16, mlp_output source, logistic regression probe with class_weight=balanced, 4x negative samples, seed=42.
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: Parse stdout line starting with METRIC:F1= for the F1 float value. Also available in the REPRODUCTION RESULTS summary block as 'ProtoMech F1 (full): <value> +/- <std>'.
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: Safe optimization levers: (1) circuit_search step_size (default 32) for finer node selection; (2) recovery_ratio (default 0.7) for higher circuit coverage targets; (3) max_nodes (default 1000) upper bound; (4) probe architecture (logistic regression vs MLP/CNN); (5) batch_size for faster evaluation; (6) sequential vs direct reconstruction mode. Do not change: CLT L6 D3200 TopK k=16 architecture, ESM2-8M backbone, dataset split seed (42), min_family_size (50), Swiss-Prot InterPro data source.
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Base image: docker.1ms.run/pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Key deps: fair-esm==2.0.0, scikit-learn, pytorch-lightning==2.1.4, transformers, polars, pandas, peft, safetensors. torchvision/torchaudio removed (incompatible with PyTorch 2.1.2 base image, not needed). HF models from ktalreja/ProtoMechModels (esm2_t6_8M_UR50D.pt 29MB, CLT_L6_D3200 346MB). HF data from ktalreja/ProtoMechData (swissprot_seqid30_75k_all_info_with_3di.parquet 48MB). Symlinks: /repo/models/* -> /models/*, /repo/data/* -> /datasets/*. Container uses HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY=172.17.0.1:17890; ALL_PROXY must be unset for HF downloads.

optimization_objective.summary: Maximize average F1 score of ProtoMech full-latent reconstruction on protein family classification across all 50 InterPro families. ProtoMech replaces ESM2 MLP layers with sparse cross-layer transcoders; F1 measures how well the reconstructed representations preserve protein family classification capability.

metrics.name: F1
metrics.rationale: Primary paper metric: measures ProtoMech full-latent reconstruction quality for protein family classification. Paper achieved 0.82; reproduction achieved 0.862 with MIN_POSITIVES=50. Higher F1 means the replacement model better preserves the original ESM2 model classification capability.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Improve F1 as much as possible within the SOTA iteration budget. A 3% regression tolerance allows minor fluctuations. If F1 regresses beyond 3%, the change is considered detrimental unless accompanied by disproportionate improvements in other dimensions.
